brief:
Search and rescue operations continued in Gaza City on Wednesday following the collapse of a bombed-out building that killed at least 20 people, UN News reported. Rescue teams worked through the rubble as authorities searched for additional survivors trapped beneath the structure.

The collapse occurred in a previously damaged building, adding to the toll of destroyed infrastructure across the enclave.
dek: Search and rescue operations continued in Gaza City on Wednesday following the collapse of a bombed-out building that killed at least 20 people, according to reports.
title: Building collapse kills at least 20 in Gaza City
